name: lore-llm-study
description: Lore LLM study mode: AWS Lambda (Function URL, response streaming) that generates quiz questions from a project's notes and grades the answers

scripts.build: esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/handler.mjs --minify --external:@aws-sdk/* --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
